project.title: Native normalized company bootstrap and early upgrades
project.goal: Create the full company schema in native Rust and migrate known normalized early prefixes on private copies.
project.scope: R12 existing empty/normalized prefixes0–31; prior suffix32–36 contract preserved, full legacy normalization and writer gates unchanged.

component.storage.description: Own bounded private SQLite migration rehearsal.

boundary.responsibility: Capture, recover, validate, migrate and discard private copies.
boundary.rationale: Original writer admission is not yet complete.
excludes: Live migrations, domain writes and promotion

action.rehearse_company_baseline.description: Bootstrap or upgrade a canonical normalized company privately using compiled public schema images and exact artifacts.

preconditions: Explicit local read authority; strict supported prefix; no migration authority inferred.
postconditions: Original source unchanged; owned private files explicitly closed/deleted.
Original typed-column projections and provenance preserved; legitimate new defaults/identities verified separately.
Each committed prefix is complete, final guards precede history36 commit; no writer authority.
external_effects: Read/stat source files; recover/migrate/delete private disposable files only.

concurrency.rationale: Capture stable source while legacy reader/writer may be active.

atomicity.rationale: Real transactional rollback and process death.

action.rehearse_company_baseline.behavior: Validate exact image/artifacts, capture private copy, require empty or strict known normalized prefix, snapshot original-column projections/provenance, transact each SQL/history step with final guards in36, verify introduced invariants/full final schema, close/delete copy and report scoped evidence.

scenario.normal.description: Exact suffix manifest/history; original files and business cells unchanged.

scenario.given: Existing empty source or canonical normalized prefix1–31.
scenario.when: Rehearse and compare independent TypeScript post-baseline migration oracle.
scenario.then: Exact current DDL and applied history; original-column data preserved; introduced defaults verified.

scenario.history.description: Refuse before migration; never adopt checksums.

scenario.given: Older/newer/gapped/tampered history or embedded artifact drift.
scenario.then: Refuse before migration; never adopt checksums.

scenario.checkpoint.description: Explicit refusal; no repair or source effects.

scenario.given: Unknown physical variant, malformed history/image or business/data invariant failure.
scenario.then: Explicit refusal; no repair or source effects.

scenario.isolation.description: Bounded capture refusal and no original SQLite connection.

scenario.then: Bounded capture refusal and no original SQLite connection.

scenario.failure.description: Its DDL/history both roll back; earlier complete steps remain.

scenario.given: A private pending step with real SQL or history insert failure.
scenario.then: Its DDL/history both roll back; earlier complete steps remain.

scenario.crash.description: Old or new complete step after recovery; child is reaped.

scenario.given: Disposable actual child at bootstrap or early migration boundary.
scenario.when: Kill after SQL or history insertion before commit.
scenario.then: Empty or complete old prefix; no partial bootstrap/step and all children reaped.

scenario.guards.description: Valid inserts succeed; invalid changes fail.

scenario.given: Legacy started purchase application after full migration and repeated opens.
scenario.when: Change key/status or delete the row in TS and native completed image.
scenario.then: All in-place operations refuse; original row stays identical.

scenario.repeat.description: No new history/data changes and canonical checkpoint verified.

scenario.then: No new history/data changes and canonical checkpoint verified.

scenario.concurrent.description: Capture concurrently active WAL source without source effects.

scenario.when: Rehearse while independent TS connection retains pending WAL.
scenario.then: Valid private recovery or bounded refusal, unchanged source inventories.

source.contract.title: Native company normalized bootstrap/early migration contract
